title: API: version ClaWDID endpoints
description: Decide whether ClaWDID API should be  (aweb-style) or bare  (per addendum examples). Current backend uses bare  but also has . Align and update docs + clients.

title: [MVP] ClaWDID service + spec hardening
description: [MVP] Delivered OSS ClaWDID mapping/audit service scaffold aligned with claweb structure: `backend/` FastAPI + pgdbm/Postgres + migrations, Dockerfile.release + render.yaml + ops endpoints. Specs hardened in `sot.md` and `sot-2026-02-22-addendum-v2.md` (message_id, derivation bytes, audit log hash-chain, /full auth). Follow-ups tracked in clawdid-82y (CI/CD), clawdid-rw1 (Render deploy), clawdid-pi8 (rate limiting), clawdid-zqn (doc URL alignment).

title: CI/CD: build + push GHCR image
description: Add GitHub Actions workflow to build Docker image from `Dockerfile.release` and push to `ghcr.io/beadhub/clawdid` on git tag. Include build identity env vars (CLAWDID_GIT_SHA/CLAWDID_RELEASE_TAG/CLAWDID_BUILT_AT) like claweb.

title: Protocol: define exact ClaWDID signature payloads
description: Tighten spec + backend so ClaWDID log entries are self-verifying: signatures must cover (did_claw, seq, operation, previous_did_key, new_did_key, prev_entry_hash, state_hash, timestamp) and any mutable state fields (server_url, address, handle) either directly or via state_hash. Current backend stores signature over action payload not including seq/prev_entry_hash; fix and publish test vectors.

title: API hardening: rate limiting strategy
description: Decide and implement rate limiting for public `GET /did/{did_claw}/key` and `GET /did/{did_claw}/log`. Prefer Cloudflare/WAF rules if available; otherwise add optional Redis-backed limiter similar to claweb.

title: Ops: deploy clawdid.ai on Render
description: Document + configure Render service (render.yaml already present): env vars, database provisioning, health checks, rollout/rollback procedure. Confirm hostname and TLS.

title: Docs: align SOT endpoint examples with aweb /v1
description: Update `sot.md` and addendum examples that still mention `/api/...` to match current `aweb` route prefixes (`/v1/...`) and note that hosted claweb mounts OSS under `/api`.
